ratings.comment: nice prof overall. class is just hard and expect your projects to not work. u still get partial credit for some features if they work. attend lectures so that ur prepared for the quizzes. a lot of quizzes and tests, no cheatsheets but if they're implementation quizzes u can access ur github. we were kinda guinea pigs for her so class was harder

she started using github this semester even tho she didn't know how to use it herself. she lectures for the first 30 min of class and then the rest of the time is lab. so u have a week to do the lab but u can also finish it the day that it's due in class. material was very confusing, wish she would've explained how to implement in code more.

Her tests and quizzes are so hard and require understanding of the material because changing one word in the question can completely change the answer. For example, the word not added or removed can require complicated steps to reach the new answer. The projects are in groups and are manageable if everyone assumes a specific role.

Prof Min teaches the Embedded track and it was the most fun track in CE in my opinion. She teaches the concepts very well and they are related to the projects. Each project will take time but are doable. She is accessible outside of class. Quiz and exam questions are pretty straightforward.
Lectures are a little dry but make sure to read over the slides. Exams are really easy as long as you study the slides and understand the material. Labs and projects are doable as well.

One of the best teachers I've had at CSULB. Follows her syllabus so nothing should be unexpected. Great at understanding problems/knows exactly how to fix them/the source. Great resource, do not be afraid to use her help, she makes it readily available for you(always there for office hours and stays an extra 5 hours.). One of the best!

Min He is amazing. She is so caring and understanding of students and their schedules and she truly wants you to learn and understand the concepts. Her projects take some time but overall she gives you everything you need to be successful. Once again amazing professor and if you have the chance to take her I would recommend doing so.

Min is one of the best professors I've had in 4 years at CSULB. She is so caring and helpful to every student and she makes her lectures and the material very easy to understand. The projects are super cool but pretty difficult and some may take hours to complete. If you can get Min for 346, 347, and 447 do it!!!
She was good! You will learn something despite being in a pandemic. If you go to her office hours, you will learn a lot more!

Not a bad professor by any means. Her tests are very straight forward, mostly from her reviews and lectures. The projects are somewhat difficult, but you need to do some self studying yourself(i.e. book) instead of just relying 100% on her lectures. The amount of work you put in is proportional to your grade.

Very nice, gets a lot of criticism for lack of teaching skills, but honestly a really smart and helpful professor. If you ask for help in lab hours she respectfully gives you the attention and does help you with debugging. Her lab assignments are fun a you learn a lot from them. Just study hard and finish the labs and at worst get a B in the class.

She can't teach at all.  I took her for Cecs 262 before and got past 100% on my final, but didn't understand anything. I thought I could take her again since she is the only one teaching Cecs 347, but I was wrong... Very wrong.
She does not have good knowledge of the materials.    Also, she is an unethical teacher.   Stay away from her class.
Not a good teacher.

She's a great professor sad that there was a petition going around which was stupid since half of the people signing never had her just followed the crowd. The class isn't hard and students need to understand that you're supposed to learn. She's straightforward with grading and class is easy. So try again if you fail.

She is great and her code is phenomenon. She might not be too good at hardware but coding she is wonders. Sad students expect class to be baby for them but if you had started picking up skills from previous courses then you'll be more than ready. Quizzes and testes are from lecture and projects. So get to them.

Ask for help among your classmates for projects and quizzes. When one person figures it out, beg him or her to show you what you need to do.  For exams, it is somewhat the same as her practice exams, but add in the projects and labs that you did earlier. She doesn't teach well and she doesn't care.
FPGA Board provided Clear lab manuals Good lecture slides Not difficult to score in quiz and midterm Final project need to do by yourself Got to learn a lot

Min He's 262 class was probably one of my easiest classes this semester. Her lectures are decent, but her exams are not too hard to do well on. For work, she gives you around six labs and four projects. All of them are pretty manageable to do except for the last one. If there is an extra credit opportunity, take it because it helps your grade a lot
Very good class learned a lot. Labs were really helpful. What she teaches is what she gives on exam. Not an easy A but timely submission of labs and projects will help a lot.

The class is relatively easy if you do the assignments because the questions on the assignments are on the quizzes . Midterms are like quizzes, so study your quizzes Although she may be unclear, she is very helpful if you visit her in her office hours. The labs are difficult, but she will practically give you the answer if you ask her for help.

This class taught me something you do in the industry. the tests are super easy but fundamental. for the project you can pick anything (touchscreen, audio, fpga). i got a job because of the project which was based on touchscreen.
She is not good. Does not know how to explain. You will get lost in labs. Bad teacher. Do not take.

You will need to learn the 8051 board on your own since she goes over the coding for the most part.  Study guides and power points will only get you through the class. Do projects ASAP never last minute. Do as many EC as you can.  If you do decent on the midterms with all the extra credit, you can get an A without needing to take the final.

Her accent makes her hard to understand most of the time. That's her only flaw though, she can't do anything about that. She's very helpful when you need guidance. If you pay attention to the class and attend the labs, she will basically tell you or strongly hint about how to do the lab assignments. Overall, a fair teacher.

very nice teacher,you need to sit in the front for you to understand because she has a very soft voice. quizzes were super easy.exams were not too hard but not easy but i thought labs were really hard.i suggest to work with a partner or make a group

Practically gives you her projects and labs, which are already a joke. Her tests aren't easy but if you study you will do fine. Hard to understand because of a thick accent and a soft voice. Doesn't teach much though so practically no point going to lecture anyways except when a project is due

I am surprised Dr Min's rate is not that high, from my own experience, if your are in CE major, only 2 professors teach you what is about CE: Dr Min teaches you what is embedded(CECS347,CECS561), Allison teaches you what is CPU.I didn't learn much from Bob and Tramel.

Overall easy class...she doesn't know how to teach the material well and relies on her power points...just use her notes and examples she provides will get you through the class...basically you're going to learn the 8051 board on your own...she gives quiz/exam study guides which makes them easy.

Dr. He is a pretty quiet professor but makes this class a pretty easy class. Around 10 lab assignments, 2 tests and a final, and a quiz before each test. She gives you study guides and the quizzes are basically the study guides.  Recommended teacher for CECS 285.

Very nice professor. Labs are challenging and you will definitely need to work and have at least a grasp of the subject.  She is helpful but will only give you hints to point you in the right direction.  Overall a good class...not the most difficult but definitely not an easy one.
Class is a lot of work, a dozen lab, two projects, plus midterms and quizzes so keep up.  You do learn a lot and the professor does a good job of teaching the class.

She's a good instructor, but the class requires a lot of work.  She usually gives a lab every class meeting, but they don't take up that much time.  She really helps you understand the material, but sometimes her lectures aren't as clear as just reading the book.  I definitely recommend her, but prepare for a fair amount of work.

Min is a very good professor. Extremely helpful during lab. Gives a lot of extra credit. Midterms programming logic problems are the worst. But she gives you an extra 1 or 2 problems in case you didn't get the others ones. The textbook is very good, written for humans unlike the 201 Greek book. Highly recommended.

Dr. Min is very nice and she teaches this topic very well. She also grades really easy and gives lots of extra credit. The lectures and labs are interesting and fun. I wouldn't change anything about this class. Also the book is very good. I almost never buy books but I was glad to have this one.

Makes otherwise difficult concepts clear and concise and teaches what SHOULD have been taught (and of course wasn't) in 346. Gives lots of examples and full working code for labs. If you do enough extra credit you don't have to take the final! If you can't get an 'A' in this class it's time to change majors.
Dr.He Min is a good teacher.  She gives good review before quiz and test. Easy to get a B for the class. Try to keep up with the labs because they are a letter grade.

lectures are kinda boring and hw and labs are tough at the beginning.  Very quiet so sit up front if u plan to pass.  Also, she is very nice about hw and labs like if a lot of people dont understand or arent done, she will postpone it or go over some answers.  Labs get easier as you progress but hw is hard a lot of the time.

She is a very nice professor who was much better the second time around.  The first time I took this course with her she gave us too much homework.  The subject is not very interesting but personally, I liked the PowerPoint lectures. I would recommend her over any other 201 professor because even though she has an accent, she is very helpful. Nice teacher, easy tests as along as you attend the class and ask questions. If you are interested in the class itself, you'll still feel it's interesting, but if you need to feel interested based on the teacher, then it's a bornig class.
She's a nice teacher, but lectures are boring. She has an accent and power point lectures are soo boring. the only good thing is, she's very nice.

She has thick accent.  The subject itself is pretty boring, so I do not think any teacher can make it exciting. She is a new teacher, but she is getting much better. The book is horrible, by far the worst textbook I have ever bought. I only used to for the homework assignments.

Man is that class boring or what. The powerpoint lecture is very boring and makes everyone in the class fall asleep. If you have no choice but to take her class be sure to take some strong caffine before going to the lecture. If you dont go to lecture be sure to check the website for new assignment.
Lectures from powerpoints are confusing if you don't pre-read the material. Assignments and tests are easy if you keep up with the material.
Sign up for the class, forget the class go straight to the lab, study powerpoint,copy friends,work in group = B.  check over your tests b/c she forgets to add. and minterm == midterm

i don't know if it's the class or the professor, but i did not understand anything during/after lectures.  everything i learned was weeks after it was lectured, and usually self-taught. accent is difficult sometimes (wrong pronunciations).  she knows what she's talking about, but hard grader/teacher
not a good teacher, avoid taking her, cannot understand lectures sometimes and hard grader take allison instead you wont regret it.
She's hard to understand, doesn't explain everything in detail, her teaching style is unorthodox, goes through powerpoint, example and expects you to get it. Class goes fast.

not a very good teacher, lectures mostly off powerpoint and doesn't clarify info. class is more difficult because could not  teach material. going to avoid taking her for any class for the rest of my major.
Not a very good teacher.  Very difficult to understand.  At least the ease of her class makes up for the ability to understand her.  She is also always willing to help you.
